# 🧰 Engineering Templates

Use these templates to make project work consistent and reviewable. Copy the relevant template into the issue, pull request or documentation area, then remove instructions that do not apply.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [ADR](adr-template.md) | Architecture, vendor or technology decisions |
| [Architecture design](architecture-template.md) | New system/component design |
| [Feature specification](feature-specification-template.md) | Scope, requirements and acceptance criteria |
| [Bug report](bug-report-template.md) | Reproducible defect reports |
| [Change request](change-request-template.md) | Change scope and impact review |
| [Code review](code-review-template.md) | Consistent pull request review |
| [QA test case](qa-test-case-template.md) | One repeatable verification scenario |
| [Test plan](test-plan-template.md) | Feature or release test strategy |
| [Test report](test-report-template.md) | Actual execution results and evidence |
| [API contract](api-contract-template.md) | A future real API endpoint, not browser routes |
| [Database schema](database-schema-template.md) | A future persistence layer; none exists today |
| [Threat assessment](threat-assessment-template.md) | Threats and mitigations |
| [Security review](security-review-template.md) | Security/privacy impact of a change |
| [Accessibility audit](accessibility-audit-template.md) | Route/component accessibility review |
| [Incident report](incident-response-template.md) | Security, privacy or availability incident |
| [Deployment record](deployment-record-template.md) | Release, smoke-test and rollback evidence |
| [Release checklist](release-checklist.md) | Release readiness |
| [Risk assessment](risk-assessment-template.md) | Risk scoring and ownership |
| [Project status](project-status-template.md) | Periodic status reporting |
| [Maintenance checklist](maintenance-checklist.md) | Recurring maintenance |

A completed template is not evidence by itself. Attach command output, screenshots, test results or review records where relevant. Do not claim a control passed merely because its checkbox is checked.
